content.text:
Run this command via PowerShell to upload the file. It is credential-free — the single-use URL is the authorization — so run it exactly as emitted; do NOT add any Authorization header or credential.

curl.exe -sS --fail-with-body -X PUT -H "Content-Type: image/png" --upload-file "C:\Users\me\Desktop\KingdomIdle\project-k\Assets\_Project\Art\Icons\MageTower\IceSpike.png" -- "https://cloud.comfy.org/api/uploads/X9pFtRYLY8NQfNpqzBwJVg"

On success it prints a JSON body like {"name":"...","subfolder":"","type":"input"} — use that "name" as the "image" value in your workflow's LoadImage node; no further upload_file call is needed. The URL is single-use with a short TTL: if the command fails (404 = used/expired), re-invoke upload_file for a fresh URL instead of re-running this one. The PUT targets the same Comfy Cloud API host this session already talks to. Files must be at most 50 MiB — a larger file returns 413 and consumes the URL, so shrink it first rather than retrying (downscale or re-encode an image; trim or re-encode audio to a lower bitrate — a long lossless WAV easily exceeds the cap).
